historical_growth.growth_rate_source: mid-cycle judgment: flat ~1.1Mt volume (P1000 + Ngungaju) with ~2.5% nominal price escalation; no historical CAGR is usable
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Every CAGR describes the lithium price cycle, not the business: 5-yr revenue +61.5% runs from the FY21 trough, 3-yr revenue -21.9% runs from the FY23 US$4,447/t peak, equity 5-yr +48% vs 3-yr +6.4%. EPS and owner-FCF 5-yr CAGRs are undefined (FY21 negative). Growth is set from volumes x mid-cycle price instead.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series: FY23 $2,867m (3,071 reported - 12.8 SBC - 191.1 interest), FY24 -$1,384m, FY25 -$556m, FY26 $962m (1,035 - 22.2 - 50.7). SBC is ~1% of revenue and does not distort the FCF CAGR; the swing is price.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle: Pilgangoora runs at ~1.05-1.1Mtpa (Pilgan P1000 + restarted Ngungaju) selling at A$1,800/t SC5.2, roughly the company's own reserve price and the long-run incentive price, 17% below FY26's average and well below the H2 FY26 spike. Margins are rebuilt from the FY27 cost guidance (FOB A$575-625/t) rather than carried from FY26's 59%. No P2000, no Colina production, P-PLS stake carried at zero. Value is ~$0.4bn/yr of owner FCF capitalised at 11% plus $1.06bn of net cash.
scenario_narratives.bull: Price recovery durable: Chinese supply discipline plus EV/storage demand hold spodumene near US$1,500/t SC5.2, P2000 is approved on the December-2026 feasibility study and funded from the cash pile and notes, taking volumes toward 2.0Mtpa by FY31. Requires BOTH a sustained price well above incentive levels AND a $1.6bn expansion delivered on time; the FY24-FY25 overbuild-then-idle cycle shows those can diverge.
scenario_narratives.bear: The 2024-25 pattern repeats: new African/South American supply and CATL-style Chinese restarts push spodumene back to cost-curve support (~US$900/t) for the decade; Ngungaju's higher-cost tonnes compress margins to ~30%; growth capital is deferred. PLS survives comfortably (net cash, no covenant pressure) but earns roughly its cost of capital.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a commodity price-taker on mid-cycle volumes and prices, not on the latest year. FY26 (US$1,488/t, 59% margin, $962m owner FCF) is a recovery year that already sits at the upper half of the cycle; the H2 FY26 price spike has not held and the share price has retraced 42% from its high. Base case charges the FY27 cost step-up (Ngungaju), 30% cash tax on an EBIT that FY26's refund flattered, and excludes every un-sanctioned growth project, then adds the $1.06bn net cash once (interest income stripped from the flows). A 12x terminal cap and a single 11% AUD WACC keep the cyclicality charge in the flows and the scenario weights.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mid-cycle price assumption (A$1,800/t SC5.2) is the single largest driver: each +/-A$200/t moves FY27 EBITDA by ~+/-$200m before tax
AUD/USD: revenue is USD-linked, costs AUD; a stronger AUD compresses A$ margins at any USD price
P2000 FID near a cyclical price peak would repeat the FY24-FY25 overbuild; the base case gives P2000 no value and no capex beyond pre-FID spend
Grade decline (1.5% -> 1.2% Li2O) and Ngungaju's higher unit cost push FOB costs up faster than assumed
China concentration: offtake, pricing benchmark and converter demand are all China-centred; policy or capacity moves reprice the whole curve
USD notes (US$600m, 6.875%, 2031) add FX and refinancing exposure a historically unlevered company did not carry

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 2.32-6.81
data_sources.financials: PLS.AX_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2016-FY2026 annual, H1 halves), FY26 Annual Report (financial review table 1-2 for volumes, realised prices, unit costs; note 5.2 borrowings and leases; note 6.3 SBC and performance rights; EPS note for dilution)
data_sources.qualitative: PLS.AX_Analysis.json (FY27 guidance: 1,030-1,100kt, FOB A$575-625/t; Ngungaju restart; P2000 $175m pre-FID; Colina feasibility Dec Q 2027; P-PLS idled)

inputs.share_count_basis: 3,257.5m ordinary shares on issue at 30 June 2026 plus 19.0m unvested performance rights (FY26 AR note 6.3 table, summed). Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows, so diluting the count as well would double-charge. No buyback programme; the Colina acquisition (Feb 2025, all-scrip, ~163m shares) is already in the count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY26 AR note 6.3 share-based payment expense $22.205m (cash-flow add-back basis); no separate equity-award tax withholding disclosed, so the combined figure equals the expense line
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-09-24T06:19:28Z (Yahoo Finance chart API, regular session; ex-dividend the 5c final was paid 24 Sep 2026)
inputs.wacc_rationale: AUD flows discounted at an AUD-built rate: 10y ACGB ~4.3% + 5.5% ERP x beta ~1.4 for a single-commodity lithium producer = ~12% cost of equity; US$600m 6.875% notes are the only borrowings and the company is net cash, so WACC rounds to 11%. One WACC for all three scenarios: price-cycle risk is charged in the mid-cycle flows and the scenario weights, not stacked again in the discount rate (adaptations rule f).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment A (leases as debt): lease liabilities of $281.4m (55.7 current + 225.7 non-current) sit inside total_debt and net debt; the $44.3m FY26 lease principal is NOT deducted from the flows; ROU depreciation stays in D&A; capex_pct is set high enough to cover lease-funded fleet renewal (~$45m/yr).
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interest of $3.8m (Mid-Stream JV, Calix interest being bought out for $11.4m) is immaterial and ignored.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF on a MID-CYCLE basis (dcf-methods routing: cyclical operating company, owner-fcf.md + adaptations). FY26 is a recovery year at US$1,488/t SC5.2 (A$2,164/t) on 891.6kt sold; H2 FY26 was materially above that and the share price has since fallen ~42% from its 52-week high, so FY26 revenue is NOT carried forward. Base year-1 revenue is rebuilt from volume x mid-cycle price: FY27 guided production 1,030-1,100kt (Ngungaju restart) -> 1,050kt sold x A$1,800/t SC5.2 (US$1,190/t at AUD/USD 0.66; the company's own reserve price is US$1,450/t SC6.0 = ~US$1,260/t SC5.2, and long-run incentive-price consensus is US$1,200-1,500/t SC6) + ~$10m tantalite = ~$1,900m. Margin is built from components each year: FOB cost at the FY27 guided A$575-625/t (Ngungaju is higher cost), freight ~A$170/t to CIF, royalties ~6.5% of revenue, corporate ~$50m -> ~47% EBITDA margin in FY27, easing to 44% as grade declines (1.5% -> 1.2% Li2O). last_fcf (owner FCF $962m) is the FY26 actual and is above mid-cycle: it includes a $74m cash-tax REFUND against a $268m tax expense and H2 pricing that has not held; the projected year-1 owner FCF (~$0.4bn) is the mid-cycle figure. Interest income stripped (net cash $1.06bn >> mid-cycle FCF); the cash sits in the bridge. P2000 (2.0Mtpa expansion, feasibility Dec Q 2026, no FID) and Colina (Brazil, feasibility Dec Q 2027) are excluded from base and bear; P2000 is the bull axis with its own capex. The 18% P-PLS hydroxide JV stake (idled H1 FY26) is unmodelled upside not added to the bridge. Cash tax 30% statutory throughout. Working-capital capture -5% of revenue change (receivables/inventory grow with sales). Data caveat: the Analysis JSON item labelled 'Q1 FY27' (224.8kt, A$251m) is the Q1 FY26 quarterly mislabelled (224,757 dmt is FY26 Q1 production in the AR) and its 'Oct 2026' spot-price claim is future-dated; neither was used as evidence.

bear.narrative: Price settles at cost-curve support ~US$900/t SC5.2 (A$1,360/t), as in FY24-FY25: FY27 revenue ~$1,410m on 1,040kt, 2% nominal thereafter, no expansion. EBITDA 33% -> 29% as FOB costs drift up with grade decline and Ngungaju's higher cost base. Sustaining capex ~$240m holds at 16-17% of the smaller revenue base.

base.narrative: FY27 revenue ~$1,900m = 1,050kt (guidance midpoint 1,030-1,100kt) x A$1,800/t SC5.2 mid-cycle; FY28 +5% as Ngungaju reaches ~1,100kt steady state; 2.5% nominal thereafter, no P2000. EBITDA 47% -> 44% (FOB A$600/t guided, grade decline). Capex 16% in FY27 (includes P2000 pre-FID $175m spend and lease-fleet renewal) then ~14% ~ D&A. 30% cash tax. 12x cap for a cyclical.

bull.narrative: Spodumene holds ~US$1,500/t SC5.2 (A$2,270/t): FY27 revenue ~$2,450m on 1,080kt. P2000 FID in FY27, ~$1.6bn capex FY28-FY31 (capex 28-32% of revenue), volumes to ~2.0Mtpa by FY31 (growth 12-15%/yr FY29-FY31). Margins 55% -> 51% as scale offsets grade decline.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 30%: a single-asset, single-commodity, China-dependent price-taker has spent three of the last eight years at cost-curve prices (FY19-21, FY25). Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs two independent things to go right, a sustained above-incentive price and a P2000 FID plus execution, and analyst 2026-28 price forecasts already span US$970-2,000/t.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
